parsed.why: No adult facility ban in force; hate-crime law covers gender identity. Harsh licence and birth-certificate regime plus pending bathroom bill are resident-facing; national passport and custody rules still bind. Slightly above the national line.

Statewide gender-identity discrimination ban enforced by a commission awarding remedies, X markers on licences, city sanctuary shielding travellers, no facility ban. National passport and entry-screening regime still caps the score below reduced-risk tiers.

School-only facility ban and minors' care ban are resident-facing, but the hate-crime statute excludes gender identity and a religious-freedom statute supplies a service-refusal route with thin recourse. Net slightly below the national line.

Criminalises non-birth-sex restroom use across government buildings and private businesses including restaurants and hospitals: a universal, jailable exposure with litigation unresolved. Adds birth-certificate ban and minors' outing law; materially below parent.

Birth-sex facility statute covering bathrooms, locker rooms, shelters and dorms, plus qualified-immunity religious-refusal permitting service denial, with no statewide protections. Universal exposure but no documented criminal penalty or enforcement, so just below parent.
